# aw2_battle_host.txt -- AW2 link battle, host side (generated by the AW
# baseline; lines from 'wait 90' to 'endrepeat' are the feasibility
# bench's aw2_link_host.txt lobby, unchanged).
wait 90
hold A+B+SELECT+START 10
wait 900
press START 4
wait 200
dump
press START 4
press DOWN 4
wait 40
dump
press DOWN 4
wait 40
dump
press DOWN 4
wait 40
dump
press DOWN 4
wait 40
dump
press DOWN 4
wait 40
dump
press DOWN 4
wait 40
dump
press A 4
wait 90
dump
press DOWN 4
wait 30
dump
press UP 4
press A 4
wait 120
wait 600
repeat 6
press A 4
wait 240
endrepeat
# ---- battle: RAM-gated turn exchange (docs/GBA-LINK-BASELINE.md) ----
# 0x0201D49C: the HUD's CO tiles, 100 while the host (P1 red) moves, 68 while
# the join (P2 blue) does; equal on both consoles (desktop, 18 turns).
# A clears the last lobby screens until the battle's HUD appears.
# Each turn: a cursor tour (out and back, the partner watches it
# live), then the map menu's End (A, DOWN x3, A).  The confirm A
# goes only while the turn is still ours.
evt battle_wait
mash A 1 0x0201D49C 0xFF 100 7200
evt battle_start
repeat 10
waitram 1 0x0201D49C 0xFF 100 9000
evt my_turn
wait 120
press B 4
wait 20
press B 4
wait 20
press RIGHT 4
wait 8
press RIGHT 4
wait 8
press RIGHT 4
wait 8
press LEFT 4
wait 8
press LEFT 4
wait 8
press LEFT 4
wait 8
press RIGHT 4
wait 8
press RIGHT 4
wait 8
press RIGHT 4
wait 8
press LEFT 4
wait 8
press LEFT 4
wait 8
press LEFT 4
wait 8
press A 4
wait 40
press DOWN 4
wait 15
press DOWN 4
wait 15
press DOWN 4
wait 15
press A 4
evt end_pressed
wait 60
ifram 1 0x0201D49C 0xFF 100 2
press A 4
evt end_confirm
waitram 1 0x0201D49C 0xFF 68 1800
evt turn_end
logram day 1 0x020238C6
endrepeat
evt battle_done
wait 600
evt end
